info.title: Able OS Cockpit
info.description: Read-only Hometown Meadows data by lot number, for Raj's desk pages. Every call is a plain GET read - nothing can be changed through this API. Tools this key may read: occupancy_status (lots by status, occupancy %, inspections), rent_status (this month: charged, collected, collection %, lots past grace, whether late fees are paused), lot_roll (per lot number: status, rent, owed, last paid, open jobs, next inspection), work_order_list (open jobs by lot), dates_list (critical dates, open documents, scheduled inspections). Each answer is {tool, data} and data carries an as_of time. No names, phones, emails, codes or screening results are ever returned.

get.summary: Read one Able OS cockpit tool (read-only)
get.description: GET /api/mcp?tool=rent_status returns {"tool":"rent_status","data":{...}}. Without ?tool it lists the tools this key may read. A tool this key may not read answers 403.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Which tool to read. Leave empty to list them.

200.description: {tool, data} - data is the tool's answer, with an as_of time.

403.description: That tool is not available to this key.
